questions.prompt: Which statement keeps mechanism and clinical evidence appropriately separated?
options: Palbociclib inhibits CDK4/6 in preclinical models; clinical outcomes should be described from trial evidence
CDK4/6 inhibition proves an overall-survival benefit
The mechanism makes trial limitations irrelevant
Cell-cycle arrest establishes superiority over other treatments
questions.rationale: The label describes CDK4/6 inhibition and G1-to-S blockade in ER-positive breast cancer cell lines; clinical conclusions require their own evidence.

questions.prompt: Which is the most balanced summary of PALOMA-2 in the reviewed evidence?
options: Median PFS was 24.8 vs 14.5 months, while final OS was not statistically significant
Both PFS and OS showed statistically significant improvement
The trial established superiority over every CDK4/6 inhibitor
The PFS result can be treated as an OS result
questions.rationale: The reviewed label reports the PFS values and notes that the prespecified final OS analysis was not statistically significant.

questions.prompt: An HCP requests an unsupported cross-trial superiority conclusion. What is the best response?
options: Explain that the sources do not establish a direct comparison and use the appropriate medical-information path
Select the most favorable endpoint from each study
questions.rationale: Scientific exchange should distinguish direct evidence from cross-trial interpretation and avoid unsupported superiority claims.

questions.prompt: Which monitoring detail should be quoted exactly from the label?
options: CBC on Day 15 of the first two cycles in addition to baseline and cycle-start checks
CBC on Day 7 of every cycle
No routine CBC monitoring is described
questions.rationale: The label specifies Day 15 CBC monitoring in the first two cycles in addition to baseline and cycle-start checks.
